children: Novedo issued SEK 83.3M of convertible bonds to settle accrued interest on its existing loan, bringing total issued to SEK 777.8M within a SEK 1,000M framework. The new bonds carry the same terms and will list on Börse Frankfurt (Open Market).
Paying interest in kind preserves cash but increases debt/dilution risk.
Signals leverage level vs. SEK 1,000M cap; 22% headroom left.
No change to pricing/structure; limits incremental covenant risk.
Enhances liquidity and price discovery for the convertibles.
Clarifies eligibility; important for bondholder positioning.

This continues Novedo’s use of its convertible program and suggests cash conservation via interest paid in kind. A larger catalyst would be refinancing terms, conversion activity, or guidance on leverage and cash flow to assess dilution risk.
